statement: Torsion enlargement outside the geometric closure order; all odd Heisenberg enlargements
notes: Registered after full root and PBC proof/source/certificate audits PASS. If m has a prime r outside the actual geometric closure order, the potential-good tame model at r, including r=2, has target torsion clusters of size c=r^{a(2-f)}. Source clusters are c or 1+e(c-1), so every cusp has a rational marked companion and A42 gives all-prime fixed inertia. Normalizer recognition inherits through the actual open immersion when known originally. Combined with A63 and a separate inert pure-p-power rational-fibre argument, this treats every odd Heisenberg prime p and every enlargement m. No cofinality, finite refinement over the original map, quotient fixed lifting, or universal-cover conclusion.
